review_comments.body: ".out" is the default so no need to specify it.
isn't the default whatever is in `outputsToInstall` ?

I look at lib/options.nix in `mkPackageOption` implementation, it uses `lib.attrByPath` to resolve the passed `name` argument, and it looks like specifying `lib.mkPackageOption pkgs "autopushrs.out" { }` is wrong syntactically and errors with `error: "autopush-rs.out" cannot be found in pkgs`, it was hidden by the fact that we set `package` value in the `passhthru` of the derivation, it should be `pkgs [ "autopush-rs" "out" ]`.

See in `nix repl -f '<nixpkgs>'`

```nix
nix-repl> x = lib.attrByPath [ "autopush-rs" ] (throw "not found") pkgs
nix-repl> y = lib.attrByPath [ "autopush-rs" "out" ] (throw "not found") pkgs
nix-repl> x == y
true

nix-repl> x = lib.attrByPath [ "autopush-rs" "fernet" ] (throw "not found") pkgs
nix-repl> y = lib.attrByPath [ "autopush-rs" "out" ] (throw "not found") pkgs
nix-repl> x == y
false

nix-repl> lib.attrByPath [ "autopush-rs.out" ] (throw "not found") pkgs
throw not found
```

As for `meta.outputsToInstall` its purpose is different, it is used to determine during install time what outputs to install into a profile by nix. Not during eval time when a package is referenced.
